source_note: Read-only reanalysis of formal arena_analysis.json and frozen completed supplement analysis. No new experiments.
interpretation: Mean +/- sample SD is an observed descriptive variability band, not a confidence interval. The five observations are not five independent seeds. The supplementary harness differs from the formal protocol. Three seed11 controls reuse the one formal and two new all-LLM runs; No Action still has a single replacement run. Fixed three-seed11 mean vs No Action under the same three-control mean is the fair seed11 baseline comparison.
